Most harnesses clip on the back - which lets your dog pull forward with their full body weight. That's sled dog mechanics.

The ParoPet No-Pull Harness clips on the front. When your dog pulls, they get redirected sideways instead of dragging you forward. Most owners see the difference on the first walk.

✓ Front-clip that stops pulling immediately
✓ Fully adjustable — fits any size or breed
✓ Padded & breathable — no rubbing or chafing
✓ Two clips and it's on

Get a FREE matching bungee lead for a limited time only.

40-day money-back guarantee. If it doesn't work, send it back.
